name: Kingdom of Romania
locator: p. 345, Population de droit, 1899 column, Roumanie and its communes rurales/urbaines
definition: De jure population of the Romanian Old Kingdom before its 1913 and 1918 territorial gains. Source date is December 1899 in the local calendar.
method: census enumeration, definitive count reproduced in the official comparative series

name: Moldavia (Romanian Old Kingdom)
locator: p. 345, Population de droit, 1899 column, Moldavie
definition: De jure population of the Old Kingdom's historic Moldavian region. It excludes Austrian Bukovina and Russian Bessarabia.
method: census enumeration, definitive count reproduced in the official comparative series

name: Muntenia
locator: p. 345, Population de droit, 1899 column, Grande-Valachie
definition: De jure population of Muntenia, the east-Wallachian historical region containing Bucharest.
method: census enumeration, definitive count reproduced in the official comparative series

name: Oltenia
locator: p. 345, Population de droit, 1899 column, Olténie
definition: De jure population of Oltenia, the west-Wallachian historical region.
method: census enumeration, definitive count reproduced in the official comparative series

name: Northern Dobruja
locator: p. 345, Population de droit, 1899 column, Dobroudja
definition: De jure population of Romanian Dobruja in its pre-1913 boundaries. It excludes Southern Dobruja.
method: census enumeration, definitive count reproduced in the official comparative series

name: Kingdom of Romania
locator: pp. 187–188, provisional communal tabulation, stable residents
definition: Provisional Old Kingdom total of residents classified as stable. It excludes persons recently or temporarily present in their commune.
method: census enumeration, provisional tabulation condensed from the official report
